2. Kept `TacticalCapabilityMatrix` — the expandable capability cards
3. Added `id="core-capabilities-section"` to the remaining section for scroll linking

Now you'll only see:
- **TacticalCapabilityMatrix**: Expandable capability cards (Biology‑Aware Drug Ranking, Biomarkers & Cohort Context, etc.)

The duplicate is removed, and clicking grid items at the top will scroll to and expand the matching capability card in the TacticalCapabilityMatrix section.
